video.scopeNote: Formulate the vertex-cover ILP, relax it, round at one half, prove feasibility and compare cost with twice the LP optimum.
video.reason: A concise graduate-course explanation devoted to LP threshold rounding, with the construction and both proof obligations clearly identified in the instructor’s description.
